title: RWT25-STREAM: amortized persistent descriptors for robust threshold witness search

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2N), the ONE RWT25-STREAM implementation in proof.md uses the complete RWT25 threshold witness/search algorithm in source.md with the explicitly changed persistent-descriptor controller of proof.md Sections3-5. Exactly k=32(n+16) copies are acquired; epsilon=1/4 under the fixed-bad-set arbitrary correlated extension model whose good marginal is exactly the ideal product. Unconditional full-secret success is at least95/128. Every branch includes all witness qubits, idle/unused slots, full-memory addresses, controller bit operations, gate generation, source fees, initialization and cleanup. No QRAM, free word operations, source inverse/control or supplied purification is assumed. Joint charged work is O(2^((1/2)n)n^2 log2n) for n>=2, with n=1 separately finite, exact time index1. The coefficient1/2 multiplies n, not sqrt(n).

structured.error_model: Among the Q acquired copies, an adversary fixes a set B of at most floor(epsilon(n) Q) malformed positions, possibly depending on N and s. The joint state is arbitrary subject to its reduced state on all other positions being exactly rho_s^{tensor (Q-|B|)}. Malformed systems may be correlated or entangled with each other and with other systems subject to that marginal promise. No source control, purification access, or preparation inverse is supplied.
